name: security-ios-ats-peer-validation-review
intent: App Transport Security exceptions and actual TLS client validation
artifacts: Info.plist ATS settings, per-domain exceptions, URLSession/custom network clients and release build.
trace: Resolve which request uses which TLS policy and whether custom challenge handling changes peer validation independently of ATS.
experiment: Use an owned endpoint and synthetic data on a test device/simulator; compare valid TLS and a mismatched test peer.
disproof: An ATS exception alone is not a demonstrated secret leak or accepted invalid peer; non-applicable network stacks require separate evidence.
repair: Apply the intended peer/transport policy in the actual client and verify legitimate network operations.
branch_decisions: ATS exceptions and custom trust callbacks affect different parts of the effective connection policy. Resolve URLSession/web/native library behavior and the production plist. An exception allowing HTTP is not proof a sensitive request uses it, while a custom accept-all trust callback may matter even with apparently strict plist settings.
